pathTokens.description: Fixed install-layout hints for brace tokens {skillsRoot} / {sharedDir}. Not relocatable; defaults match the installer. Agents expand before tool calls. See tools.md § Path tokens.

skillsRoot.description: Expand {skillsRoot}. Install contract; do not relocate.

workingBranch.description: Active delivery branch used by ship-pr / Step 8–9

providers.description: Work-item/spec source and SCM host. Optional: when omitted, infer active from issueTrackers.*.enabled (GitHub if enabled, else Azure DevOps, else local); scm defaults to active when active is github|azure-devops, or from project.repoUrl host when active is local.

active.description: Provider skill for fetch-to-spec / entry registration. When set, overrides bare-number tracker preference from issueTrackers.*.enabled.

scm.description: Provider skill for create-pr, list-threads, resolve-thread, merge-pr, and remote validate-auth. Never local. Hybrid allowed: active=local with scm=github|azure-devops.

mutationTest.description: Optional mutation-testing command (Stryker, PIT, mutmut, etc.). Empty/unset skips the ws-testing mutation substep.

mutationThreshold.description: Minimum mutation score percent (killed/(killed+survived)*100) required to pass Step 7 when mutation runs.

testGlobs.description: Machine test-surface patterns. Testing auto-skip requires no non-empty test alias and no matching file.

skipMutationTesting.description: Skip the Step 7 mutation substep inside ws-testing (opt-in when false and verification.mutationTest is set).

scoreAndRefine.description: Optional extra Pass 1 scoring and 2nd pass polish when Step 5 score is already >= minVerifyScore (default 9) (wide-context overengineering sweep and unused workflow-introduced artifact removal). A score below minVerifyScore always runs scoreAndRefine until >= minVerifyScore, even when this flag is false.

minVerifyScore.description: Minimum ledger-derived 0-10 score to Advance Step 5, stop the mandatory scoreAndRefine loop, flag tasks, and set merge_verify_review requiresFix from verify score. Omitted or invalid values resolve to 9 at runtime.

autoload.description: When true, consumer intends repo-root AGENTS.md to autoload Always-applied skills from {sharedDir}/autoload.md. Omitted or missing config → effective false.

autoloadTaskLifecycle.description: When true, ws-configure-project --write-autoload includes ws-task-lifecycle in the Always-applied table. Omitted or false → on-demand only. Does not set defaults.autoload.

enableDag.description: When true, break execution plans into multiple parallel tasks executed concurrently by subagents. When false (default), execute tasks sequentially one by one in serial order.

verboseMode.description: Seed/schema default true (config.json.example and ws-configure-project writes). Runtime: effective only when the JSON value is explicit true; omitted or false → silent. The executing model reasons about this run and prints a Starting step N (label) bullet preview before any tool call. Do not ship canned preview text.

contextBudget.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes in one complete standard subagent dispatch.

parallelVerifyReview.description: Allow standard Steps 5 and 6 to run concurrently as read-only reviewers after an immutable product commit.

deliveryCommitArtifacts.description: Which {us-dir} artifacts to stage in the Step 8 delivery commit. Missing object or omitted keys merge to AC1 defaults at read time (includeRefinedPlan true; includeDeliveryResult and all opt-ins false). Never silently fall back to legacy always plan+result.

includeRefinedPlan.description: When true, stage step-02-{slug}.plan.refined.md if present, else step-01-{slug}.plan.md (fail closed if neither exists).

includeDeliveryResult.description: When true, stage step-08-{slug}.result.md. Default false (result may still be written for orch evidence).

includeSpec.description: When true and file exists, stage step-00-{slug}.spec.md.

includeCheckReport.description: When true and file exists, stage step-05-{slug}.plan.report.md.

includeCodeReview.description: When true and file exists, stage step-06-{slug}.review.md.

includeTestingReport.description: When true and file exists, stage step-07-{slug}.testing.report.md.

plannerModel.description: Preferred LLM model name for planning phase (Steps 0-3) in autoMode.

executionModel.description: Preferred LLM model name for execution phase (Step 4) in autoMode.

reviewerModel.description: Preferred LLM model name for check-implementation and code-review (standard Steps 5-6) in autoMode.

testingModel.description: Preferred LLM model name for the test executor (standard Step 7) in autoMode. Empty or omitted resolves to executionModel at dispatch time.

modelsPreset.description: Named key in modelPresets selecting the active preset bundle. Unknown names fall back to preset default when present, else legacy four phase keys.

modelPresets.description: Reusable preset bundles (custom names allowed). Each preset may define phase keys and an optional steps string map.

fixPrPlan.description: Fix-PR batch planning role; falls back to reviewerModel and never numeric Step 9.

fixPrExec.description: Fix-PR batch execution role; falls back to executionModel and never numeric Step 9.

steps.description: Per-step or substep overrides (numeric "0"–"9", dag, scoreAndRefine, reviewFix, fixPrPlan, fixPrExec).

fixPrPlan.description: Fix-PR batch planning role; falls back to reviewerModel and never numeric Step 9.

fixPrExec.description: Fix-PR batch execution role; falls back to executionModel and never numeric Step 9.

stepModels.description: Per-step or substep model overrides (numeric "0"–"9", dag, scoreAndRefine, reviewFix, fixPrPlan, fixPrExec). Not the state frontmatter stepModels list.

specsDir.description: Repo-relative directory for human-facing local specs. Skill token {specsDir} ← plans.specsDir (default: .agents/specs). Prefer existing repo-root specs/ when already present. ws-write-spec writes here only; used by ws-local-spec-provider, ws-spec-index, ws-spec-list, ws-multi-spec, ws-sync-spec; workflow step-00 copies under plans.dir come from providers or register

diagnosticsDir.description: Configured root for explicitly persisted dated doctor and harness reports.

worktreesDir.description: Worktree root template; {slug} substituted at runtime. Prefer nesting under plans.dir (e.g. .agents/plans/{slug}/worktrees).

useWorktrees.description: When true, prefer git worktree isolation for Step 4 implement (non-win32, path length ≤180, git worktree add succeeds).

dir.description: Root for local PR review round reports (fix-pr / ws-goal-fix-pr)

preview.description: Optional ws-preview pipeline review dry-run settings.

stack.description: Stack id override for external review dry-run (defaults to stack.id when unset).

backend.description: External review backend. v1 uses cursor-reviewer only; agentic-code-reviewers reserved for future.

tracking.description: Optional tracking-file list for ws-task-lifecycle Completion.

featuresMdEnabled.description: When true (default if omitted), the features file participates in the default Completion walk (auto-detected: repo-root FEATURES.md when it exists, else {specsDir}/index.PRD). When false, skip the features file entirely.

canonicalFiles.description: Repo-relative tracking files walked in listed order. Absent or empty → auto-detected features file (when tracking.featuresMdEnabled is not false), PLAN.md, PRODUCT.PRD. An explicit list replaces the default entirely (include FEATURES.md or index.PRD yourself if wanted).

specMemo.description: External spec-memo vault bridge (ws-spec-memo). When enabled is explicit true, memory/changelog ops route to memo MCP/CLI instead of in-repo MEMORY.

enabled.description: Explicit true enables vault bridge; omitted or false keeps in-repo ws-self-learning.

mode.description: vault = vault-only writes; hybrid = fallback to in-repo MEMORY on MCP/CLI failure.

bootstrapOnSession.description: When enabled, recommend memo bootstrap at session start.

writeBlockHook.description: True when memo hook install succeeded during setup.

importOnEnable.description: Whether setup runs memo import when enabling vault.

mcpServerName.description: Expected MCP namespace id in agent host.

invariants.description: Project invariants and workflow bypass toggles.

skipQualityGates.description: When true, same effect as the --skip-gates CLI flag: bypass quality gates (classifier enforcement, fable quality visibility except auditVerdictsBlockShip + REFUTED, pre-advance CI, telemetry soft gates). Does not skip build, test, security, SCM, or HS-1..HS-4.

auditVerdictsBlockShip.description: REFUTED always blocks. caveats additionally blocks VERIFIED WITH CAVEATS.
